newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt firm to float 50 mln pound mutual fund.
newsitem.headline: Egypt firm to float 50 mln pound mutual fund.

text.p: Egypt's Orient Trust Company (OTC) said on Monday it was inviting investors to buy units in an equities-based mutual fund with a 50 million pound capital.
OTC said it was offering investors 45,000 units worth 1,000 pounds each in the capital-accumulation fund. It will keep the remaining 5,000 units.
The firm, with a capital of 10 million pounds, said minimum subscription would be 10 units.
Unit prices will be calculated each week based on the average changes in the stock prices.

Dividends can be paid at the end of the financial year if the unit's capital value exceeds 1,200 pounds, or 20 percent of its value at the time of subscription, which will be open for Egyptians and foreigners.
OTC will put up the units of its fund for sale for two months from November 27. If the offer is covered, the firm can close it after a minimum period of 15 days.
Investors will receive units on a pro-rata basis if the offer is oversubscribed.
